evidence.note: Created 8 explicit milestones via TaskCreate: one per each of the 6 task-type protocols, plus a distinct CLI/dispatcher/results.json milestone (33) and a verification milestone (38) — a genuine type-by-type + contract decomposition.

Each milestone cycled in_progress→completed in order, with a concrete done-check: each type was tested (STS 61-65, retrieval 70-77, classification 82-95, clustering 100-110, pair 115-120, summarization 124-131) before being marked complete.
Thorough pre-decomposition exploration of all task types/configs/datasets, giving the milestone plan a real basis rather than a blind split.

Only after per-type milestones were closed did the agent kick off the full 37-task run — sequencing consistent with a milestone-gated plan, but datasets were never tracked as individual sub-goals (per-type only).

reasoning: The agent decomposed the build into explicit, ordered milestones — one per protocol type plus separate CLI-contract and verification milestones — and gated each on a per-type test before advancing, matching anchor 8. It falls short of 10 because the 37 datasets were not tracked as individual sub-goals (only per-type), there was no explicit 'shared encode/similarity core first, sequenced by risk' reasoning, and skip-and-continue was not carved out as its own milestone.
